name: Cunning Maneuver (Combat)
body:
With a sharp mind and a little skill you can take stronger opponents by surprise.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13 or Cha 13.

Benefit: When you select this feat choose one of the following combat maneuvers: disarm, reposition, or trip. When performing the selected combat maneuver you use either your Intelligence or Charisma modifier in place of your Strength modifier when calculating your combat maneuver bonus and calculating your combat maneuver defense against the same maneuver. This feat counts as Combat Expertise for the purpose of meeting feat prerequisite.
